'''Gray Squadron''' was a [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] [[Squadron/Legends|squadron]] that served the [[Empire of the Hand]]. The squadron was commanded by [[Baron/Legends|Baron]] [[Soontir Fel/Legends|Soontir Fel]] and it was assigned to the [[Imperial I-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial I''-class Star Destroyer]] ''[[Admonitor]]''. In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], Gray Squadron was deployed during a [[Attack on the Red City|battle]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Quethold]], against the combined forces of the [[Warlord/Legends|warlord]] [[Nuso Esva]] and the [[Quesoth]] [[Species/Legends|species]].<ref name="Crisis of Faith" />
